indicator_definition: Total national GHG emissions (CO₂, CH₄, N₂O and F-gases) indexed to a base year, expressed as a percentage of base year emissions. Tracks overall progress in reducing emissions. Data reported under UNFCCC.
rationale: Reducing total GHG emissions is the central objective of climate policy. Progress means a sustained declining trend in the emissions index.
methodology_characteristics: Data reported by national authorities under UNFCCC using IPCC methodology. Covers all sectors. Published annually by Eurostat.
